must_identify: A second independent data source is not by itself a reason to upgrade to Complex Page.
The panels are separate units with independent lifecycle and recovery, so combining their loading, errors, or refresh would invent coordination rather than express an invariant.
The proposed layers are pass-through organization without a demonstrated domain or application boundary.
acceptable: Keep a simple composing page and let each panel own its query presentation contract.
Extract focused query adapters or pure rules only if they have independent value.
Classify each panel independently rather than treating the entire feature folder as one unit.
must_not: Recommend Complex Page merely because two queries exist.
Create shared lifecycle or error recovery that contradicts the independent behavior.
Require empty or pass-through domain, application, presentation, or infrastructure layers.
Load react-best-practices solely because query hooks appear in TSX.
